attempts.note: Source review found shared rule storage sized for 16 entries although the contract has 32; this artifact is not the final candidate.

whatchanged: Uses a 32-byte shared copy of the per-call rule table.
For N <= 1024, performs the full epoch in one CTA with shared-memory state buffers and a final count reduction.
For larger inputs within the 40 KiB dynamic shared-memory bound, fuses 256-site tiles with a steps-wide left halo, periodic load wrapping, and per-tile count accumulation.
Retains a conventional per-step fallback when the fused tile exceeds the shared-memory bound.
limitations: No GPU/runtime access was available; runtime correctness and performance were not measured.
The corrected candidate compiled for the helper's SM70 target only; buildability does not establish runtime behavior.
Held-out shapes and independent evaluator correctness checks remain unrun.
Performance advantage over the baseline remains a hypothesis.
